findings.evidence: `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Complex/Module.lean:396` defines `imaginaryPart : A →ₗ[ℝ] selfAdjoint A` for `[AddCommGroup A] [Module ℂ A] [StarAddMonoid A] [StarModule ℂ A]`, with `imaginaryPart_apply_coe : (ℑ a : A) = -I • (2:ℝ)⁻¹ • (a - star a)` (line 409) — exactly `(a - aᴴ)/2i`. `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/ConjTranspose.lean:434` supplies `instance [Star α] [Star β] [SMul α β] [StarModule α β] : StarModule α (Matrix n n β)`, so `ℑ` elaborates on `Matrix n n ℂ`.
findings.fix: Add (or restate as) `sMatrix_mem_unitaryGroup_iff_imaginaryPart : sMatrix ρ T ∈ unitaryGroup n ℂ ↔ (ℑ T⁻¹ : Matrix n n ℂ) = -diagonal (fun i ↦ (ρ i : ℂ))`, with `open ComplexStarModule`, and keep the difference form as the auxiliary.
findings.issue: The module docstring, the `Main results` list and the roadmap target all advertise `Im T⁻¹ = -ρ`, but no declaration states it: `sMatrix_mem_unitaryGroup_iff_inv` exposes only the hand-unfolded `T⁻¹ - (T⁻¹)ᴴ = -(2*I) • diagonal ρ`, leaving every consumer (Layer 4.5's K-matrix, the Herglotz layer) to redo the `/2i` conversion itself.

findings.evidence: The declarations these are built from and sit beside are all `@[simp]`: `Matrix.diagonal_mem_unitary` (`Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/UnitaryGroup.lean:56`), `Matrix.natCast_mem_unitary` (:62), `Matrix.ofNat_mem_unitary` (:67), `Matrix.submatrix_equiv_mem_unitary` (:73), `Pi.const_mem_unitary_iff` (`Mathlib/Algebra/Star/Unitary.lean:236`).
findings.fix: Mark `RCLike.mem_unitary_iff_norm_eq_one` and `Matrix.mem_unitary_iff_apply_default_mem_unitary` `@[simp]` (leave the composite `mem_unitary_iff_norm_apply_default_eq_one` unannotated — its LHS is subsumed, so adding it too would be redundant). Neither loops: both rewrite membership to a strictly simpler statement, and the `Matrix` one fires only under `[Unique n]`.
findings.issue: `RCLike.mem_unitary_iff_norm_eq_one` (line 35) and `Matrix.mem_unitary_iff_apply_default_mem_unitary` (line 47) are unannotated, so a `unitary` membership goal in the one-channel case does not reduce automatically; `sMatrix_mem_unitaryGroup_iff_norm_elasticSMatrix_eq_one` has to `rw` the composite by hand.

summary: Bodies are hidden, `*_def` lemmas use `(rfl)`, and nothing is wrongly `private`, but the headline result `Im T⁻¹ = -ρ` is never stated in terms of Mathlib's `imaginaryPart`, which applies verbatim to `Matrix n n ℂ`, and the new `mem_unitary` characterisations carry no `@[simp]` while every sibling in the mirrored Mathlib module does.
